objective: Prove the fractional split-domination analogue and exact B(n) extremum for all chordal graphs, with explicit signed duals and separate integer-rounding obligations.

atomic_claims.text: A maximum weighted clique neighborhood and a PEO ending there compress any feasible dual objective to a same-order complete split graph.
The maximum fractional edge-and-triangle partition value over n-vertex chordal graphs is B(n); so is the maximum all-clique fractional value.
With s=B(n)-lambda(G), the integer edge-and-triangle partition value is B(n)+2(nu_star-nu)-s; a linear bound on this excess remains unproved.
K4 has lambda=2 and p23=4; J(3,2) has cp_f=3 and cp=4, so integer conclusions cannot be copied from the relaxations.
